scope: Full-manuscript import and structural verification for all 75 essays. Selected complete readings, Chinese-source opening/section/conclusion comparisons, targeted cross-language editorial corrections and reference checks. This is not exhaustive line-by-line linguistic review of all 75 texts, nor frame-by-frame verification of the films.

preservation.received: Source Markdown copied without alteration; producer checksums verified and independent SHA-256 receipt retained.
preservation.legacy: Existing simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese and English essay bodies preserved; language menus and alternate links only.
preservation.full_text: Full supplied essays, all numbered sections retained; no replacement with summaries.

local_corrections: The Truman Show, all five languages: bus trouble prevents departure; do not assert it had already left. Generalize fastening to the boat rather than an unverified exact mast attachment.
The Legend of 1900, all five languages: marriage is among possible ordinary lives open to Max, not established biographical fact.
Hachi, all five languages: distinguish Carl's refusal to take in the dog at the station from a blanket prohibition on dogs.
delivery_corrections_checked_or_retained: The Truman Show: fear's existence versus its right to decide; circular traffic experiment and uncertain motives remain distinct from factual certainty.
Hachi: 2009 American adaptation distinguished from historical Hachiko; 1932 newspaper and 1934 statue dates checked; animal interior life remains open.
The Legend of 1900: two-right-arms joke preserves the replacement logic; interpretation does not idealize the final death or erase Max's disagreement.

3 Idiots: graduation is not treated as a prerequisite for Farhan's move into photography; the watchman's impaired vision is limited to night; later success does not retroactively justify all interventions.
The Chorus: audition opportunity distinguished from later admission/scholarship results; children and adult supervisor not reduced to a future celebrity's success.

reference_checks.use: Niccol shooting-script mirror: bus cannot depart; fastening point differs from source wording. Used for bounded cross-check, not as conclusive proof of every released-film frame.
Distributor's identification and synopsis of the Hachi adaptation.
Odate tourism/HACHI100 historical timeline: 1932 newspaper recognition, statue in 1934 while Hachiko was alive.
Published screenplay mirror: Farhan photographed graduation without a robe; watchman could not see at night.
Secondary public French dialogue transcription; limited scene/dialogue cross-check, not represented as an official screenplay.
